demo_out=[[0]*13 for _ in range(19)]

for r in range(4,6): demo_out[r][8]=3
for r in range(7,9): demo_out[r][10]=3
for r in range(7,11): demo_out[r][7]=3

def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(r for r,c in pts)
    row=max(cnt,key=lambda r:cnt[r])
    o=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in pts: o[r][c]=2
    cols_same=[c for r,c in pts if r==row]
    for c in range(min(cols_same)+1,max(cols_same)): o[row][c]=3
    for r,c in pts:
        if r==row: continue
        for rr in range(min(r,row)+1,max(r,row)): o[rr][c]=3
    return o
